summary: A small computer model, rather than tests in people, estimated a high risk score of 70 for the liver and a low risk score of 40 for the heart [M]. In research, one follow-up study stopped early because of a choice to end the program rather than safety issues [4]. A separate study was also terminated early because the sponsor decided to end it [5]. Additionally, another trial stopped because of a choice to discontinue developing the experimental treatment combination containing the drug [6].
